question: Who among the following was appointed as Director General (DG) of the Border Security Force (BSF) in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daljit Singh Chaudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daljit Singh Chaudhary** was appointed as the **Director General (DG) of the Border Security Force (BSF) in August 2024**. His appointment was approved by the Indian Government for his excellence in service and leadership skills.
 
• The **BSF**, also known as the **first line of defence**, is one of India’s largest paramilitary forces tasked with guarding India's land borders during peacetime and preventing trans-border crimes.
 
• **Daljit Singh Chaudhary** is a senior Indian Police Service (IPS) officer known for his **extensive experience in security and law enforcement**, making him a suitable candidate for this position.
 
• The appointment of the DG of BSF is crucial for ensuring **effective border management** and maintaining the integrity of Indian territory.
 
• His leadership is expected to strengthen the operational capabilities of the BSF, particularly in tackling challenges like **cross-border infiltration and smuggling**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Border Security Force (BSF):**

 
 
• Established on **1 December 1965**, the BSF is under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)**.
 
• It is tasked with **border guarding duties** and **counter-insurgency operations** along India's international borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh.
 
• The BSF is the **world's largest border guarding force**, with over 257,000 personnel as of recent estimates.
 
• It also plays a vital role in **disaster management and counter-terrorism operations** within the country.
 
 
 
• **Appointment of DG in Central Armed Police Forces:**
 
 
• The DG of a central armed police force like the BSF is typically chosen from the senior-most IPS officers in the country.
 
• Appointments are made by the central government based on factors like **experience, leadership skills, and expertise in handling national security issues**.
 
• The tenure of the DG varies but is generally for a fixed period, depending on the policies of the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Key Responsibilities of BSF DG:**
 
 
• Ensuring the **integrity and security** of India's land borders during peacetime.
 
• Preventing activities such as **illegal immigration, smuggling, and infiltration** across the border.
 
• Providing **support to the army** during wartime and maintaining law and order in border areas.
 
• Implementing new **technologies and strategies** to enhance border surveillance and security.
 
 
 
• **Other Senior Officers in Consideration:**
 
 
• **Amrit Mohan Prasad**: An IPS officer known for his contributions to police modernization but not selected for the BSF DG role in 2024.
 
• **Pankaj Kumar Singh**: A distinguished officer and the former DG of the BSF (appointed in 2021).
 
• **Nitin Agarwal**: A senior officer with expertise in counter-insurgency operations but not appointed as the DG of BSF in 2024.
